name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Route 1)
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with valid Sales Order payload satisfying Glovia_Route_SalesOrder condition
expected_outcome: HTTP 200/202 Success, message enriched with standard headers, routed through Message Mapping 1 and Interface_Generic_Headers, terminates at EndEvent_2
validates: CallActivity_4 (Property/Header initialization), ExclusiveGateway_80 (Route SequenceFlow_82), CallActivity_102 (Message Mapping), CallActivity_13, EndEvent_2

name: Sales Order Return Processing (Route 2)
trigger: Inbound SOAP message satisfying Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder condition
expected_outcome: HTTP 200/202 Success, message enriched with standard headers, routed directly to CallActivity_71 and terminates at EndEvent_9

name: Unmatched Routing Condition - Escalation End
trigger: Inbound SOAP message with unknown or unmatched order type not satisfying any configured router condition
expected_outcome: Message routes to SequenceFlow_110 (Default Route) and terminates at EndEvent_11 with Escalation error code 'RoutingConditionNotMet'

name: Integration Process Error - Exception Subprocess Activation
trigger: Inbound SOAP request triggering a runtime fault during message mapping execution
expected_outcome: Exception Subprocess (SubProcess_91) triggers; CallActivity_97 restores InputPayload; CallActivity_100 logs payload; terminates at EndEvent_95 returning SOAP Fault

name: Network Timeout / Downstream Receiver Failure
trigger: Downstream system timeout during synchronous endpoint communication
expected_outcome: Connection error handled, caught by Exception Subprocess or mapped to client failure response without uncaught process crash
validates: Robust error handling and graceful degradation during network timeout
